title: notch
description: The notch (dynamic island): style, edge, hover/click expansion, media preview and what it shows when idle.

enabled.title: Enabled

x-settings.label: prefs.layout.builder
x-settings.keywords: layout builder bar notch dock edge drag move hide show disable style align composable parts corner pills

enabled.description: Show the notch at rest. Off, its live activities move to the bar (or to corner pills without a bar) and it only appears while it shows a view.

position.title: Position
position.description: The screen edge the notch sits on.

align.title: Alignment
align.description: Where the notch sits along its edge. Panels always open toward the middle of the screen.

x-settings.label: prefs.notch.align
x-settings.keywords: notch align alignment left right corner start center end

hoverRegionHeight.title: Reveal area
hoverRegionHeight.description: Height of the edge area that reveals a hidden notch.

keepHidden.title: Keep Hidden
keepHidden.description: Hide the notch until the pointer reaches it.

noMediaDisplay.title: No Media Display
noMediaDisplay.description: What the notch shows when nothing is playing.

x-settings.label: shell.no_media_display
x-settings.keywords: idle text user host compositor custom nothing playing

customText.title: Custom Text
customText.description: Text shown in the idle notch.

disableHoverExpansion.title: Disable Hover Expansion
disableHoverExpansion.description: Don't grow the notch into a media preview on hover.

hoverExpandDelay.title: Hover expand delay
hoverExpandDelay.description: Hover time before the notch expands.

hoverCollapseDelay.title: Hover collapse delay
hoverCollapseDelay.description: Delay before the expanded notch collapses after the pointer leaves.

expandOn.title: Open Panels On
expandOn.description: Open media, activities and download panels on hover or only on click.

x-settings.label: shell.notch.expand_on
x-settings.keywords: notch panel expand open hover click activities media downloads

expandedMediaWidth.title: Expanded media width
expandedMediaWidth.description: Width of the expanded media card.

expandedArtworkSize.title: Expanded artwork size
expandedArtworkSize.description: Album art size in the expanded media card.

microphoneNoticeDuration.title: Microphone notice duration
microphoneNoticeDuration.description: How long the microphone mute/unmute notice stays.

visualizer.title: Audio Visualizer
visualizer.description: Audio bars next to the playing media.

style.title: Style
style.description: Attached to the screen edge, a floating island, or a pill that shrinks to a dot when idle.

x-settings.label: prefs.notch.theme
x-settings.keywords: notch style island attached floating pill dot minimal

activities.title: Island activities
activities.description: What the island shows and where. Drag to reorder, choose a side, switch each one on or off.

x-settings.label: prefs.notch.island_activities
x-settings.keywords: island activities order reorder drag side left right enable media osd volume brightness battery charging bluetooth extras install timers privacy

osd.title: Volume and brightness in the island
osd.description: Show volume, microphone and brightness changes as a short level in the island.
